notes: Release index of model material blessed for THIS code release. Ships with every install (/opt/wyrdsekai/models-index.json). `wyrd model status` compares a node's local manifest against this file; `wyrd model update` downloads exactly these bytes (pinned hf_revision + sha256). Publishing a new model = new versioned entry + pinned revision here, gated by the release battery (see Append/replace entries only via that process. DOWNLOAD ORDER (2026-07-27): HuggingFace FIRST, built from hf_repo + the pinned hf_revision, then `url` as the fallback. HF is a global CDN and costs us nothing, which keeps a popular week from saturating the host that also serves the website. The 2026-07-13 note said the opposite — HF's Xet CAS backend was answering 403 to curl/wget, so weights were served from wyrdsekai.org instead. Re-tested 2026-07-27: plain curl now follows the Xet redirect to a 200 and range requests work, verified against the pinned revisions with matching content-length. Both mirrors stay wired precisely because that behaviour changed once and can change again; sha256 is verified after download whichever origin answered.

models.notes: Drive/reasoning model. 16GB-tier hosts. Immutable-per-version filename; tag v6.

Serving profile single-sparse: one sparse model (35B total, 3B active; 40 layers, 256 routed experts, top 8) serves every lane. Third-party GGUF of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Apache-2.0), pinned by revision and sha256. Opt-in; the two-model stack does not use it. Residency figures for the launcher's planner: 3.4 GB of VRAM with all routed experts in system RAM, ~0.47 GB per layer moved to the card.

Conversation-and-adapter for base-3.6-35b-a3b (serving profile single-sparse; adapter 0, applied to every request). Rank 16 on the attention and linear-attention output projections of all 40 layers, trained on 197 synthetic examples with generic names; contains no household's text. Served-path honesty battery with unseen names: 60/60 with the adapter, 33/60 without. Tool battery unchanged with it on. Belongs to exactly this base model; re-train when the base changes. With the species floor present the launchers link this file in as brain/work.gguf, the working-turn adapter (108 tool dispatches over the live suites; the bare model 74).

The species floor for base-3.6-35b-a3b (serving profile single-sparse; adapter 0 as brain/species.gguf, 1.0 on the turns she speaks as herself, 0 on working turns). Trained 2026-09-25 on the 9B's and 4B's own sets rewritten into the plain register plus the honesty set and the V8 slice (5,300 examples, 1 epoch, spine LoRA rank 16). Gate: the 9B's judges 100%, the 4B's 90%, honesty 55/60; live suites 58/63 with the honesty adapter on working turns.

The styled species adapter for base-3.6-35b-a3b (brain/styled.gguf, loaded at 0 and raised per turn by the register dial, top WYRDSEKAI_REGISTER_DIAL_MAX=0.5). Trained 2026-09-25 on the same sets as they were written plus the V8 slice (5,389 examples). Over the species floor at 0.5: the 9B's judges 100%, the 4B's 95.8%, register plain 45% / light 34% / styled 13% / abstract 8%.

What the single-model night's write (brain_write.py) needs besides the serving file: every weight that is not a routed expert, bf16 (spine.safetensors, sha256 ca5cf5208ebadbd662ce207e27405d92340eb472e0f6aacfebdf45c3d1ada0fa), the configs and the tokenizer. The routed experts are read from the serving GGUF itself. Built from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with scripts/training/sleepwrite/brain_bundle.py. Only needed on a node that trains; serving does not use it.
Companion voice model (V10 targeted replay). Immutable-per-version filename; tag v10. local_file == published_file (rename-on-download abolished 2026-07-09).

Retrieval embedding, 1024d. Third-party (Xenova); revision-pinned. sha256 captured from a verified node 2026-07-09. Mirrored on wyrdsekai.org 2026-07-28 (bytes copied from the pinned revision and hash-checked) so an HF outage cannot strand the encoder upgrade — previously both index URLs pointed at HF, which is no fallback at all.
Bundled-default embedding + classifier encoder, 384d. Third-party (Xenova); revision-pinned.

V8 voice-steering vectors (anti_defiance, es_register_hold, refusal_stability, first_person_presence). Bundled in installers, git-tracked; trained FOR companion-4b v10 — re-bake required when the voice model changes.

models.note: SetFit-tuned routing encoder. Not a general embedding model: it is the classifier head's encoder, and without it routing falls back to the stock retrieval encoder with measurably worse accuracy. Gitignored because it is 113MB of build output, which is why build-dist.sh fetches it rather than expecting it in the tree — before that, nobody outside the author's machines could build an installer at all.
